NEOW.talk.FROSTSWORN_CHARACTER_FROSTSWOR: The chill you bring... cannot stop this place.
Then let me keep climbing. Some things are worth preserving.
OROBAS.talk.FROSTSWORN_CHARACTER_FROSTSW: You hide the past in ice and think it will never change?
I just don't want to lose it again.
Then let us see what you are willing to pay.
PAEL.talk.FROSTSWORN_CHARACTER_FROSTSWOR: Your hands are cold. How long have you been walking?
Long enough that I can no longer remember what spring looks like.
Take this for now. Your road is not over.
TEZCATARA.talk.FROSTSWORN_CHARACTER_FROS: Even ice can burn, if you are willing to pay the price.
I know. It is often the caster who burns away.
NONUPEIPE.talk.FROSTSWORN_CHARACTER_FROS: The blizzard behind you is still chasing you.
It isn't chasing me. It follows me.
I hope you still remember how to make it stop.
TANX.talk.FROSTSWORN_CHARACTER_FROSTSWOR: Give something frozen a knock and you'll know how sturdy it is.
Some things can never be put back together once they break.
Then choose something that can stay with you a little longer.
VAKUU.talk.FROSTSWORN_CHARACTER_FROSTSWO: You have preserved so much, yet left yourself in winter.
At least I can still choose where to go.
Then continue. Let me see what you choose.
DARV.talk.FROSTSWORN_CHARACTER_FROSTSWOR: There are cracks in your ice.
Good. Don't let them cut you first.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.FROSTSWORN_CHARACTER_: You think freezing this place will make everything stop?
I no longer want to stop.
